name: Delaplex Ltd.
summary: Delaplex Ltd. is an IT software and technology consulting firm that provides technology and software development solutions. The company offers services including supply chain consulting, custom software development, cloud services, and data science. Its supply chain consulting optimizes operations through strategic planning, process improvement, and data-driven insights, encompassing warehouse and transportation management systems. Custom software development covers areas such as business intelligence, web and mobile applications, e-commerce, and IoT. Cloud services involve consulting, engineering, migration, optimization, and managed cloud solutions, while data science offerings include predictive analytics, data engineering, business intelligence, and AI/ML. Delaplex also provides other technology solutions like DevOps, security, and data analytics. The company operates as a global technology partner, primarily serving a diversified customer base in the United States across various industries such as Broadcasting, Petroleum, Retail, Logistics (3PL), Workforce Management, Quick Service Restaurants, Hospitality, IT & ITES, and Telecom. It functions as an outsourced product development partner, assisting firms in transitioning to cloud-native environments and focusing on automation, IT initiatives, and digital tools to enhance efficiency and optimize supply chains. The company also delivers managed services and staff augmentation to its clients.
